source.rulesVersion: 2024 baseline unless active entry says otherwise

compendium.summary: Concentration-based, target-specific deception for a Wizard who can present a believable threat. Its outcome depends on the active spell text and illusion adjudication, not unlimited narrative control.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Agree on what the target perceives and how it can investigate the illusion before treating this as an encounter plan. Different tables give the same image very different practical value.
The research highlights it as a stronger single-target option than its terse existing index entry suggested. Compare its save, follow-up actions and concentration demand with Web or Suggestion.
Do not turn the illusion into automatic blindness, a physical cage, forced movement or any other condition the spell does not actually impose.
